verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss's own API documentation states that webhooks can notify you about account events, so this is a first-party capability rather than a workaround. The evidence is a single index-level line, so the depth of the subscription mechanism is unproven. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription endpoint, list of subscribable event types, payload/signature verification details, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Use webhooks to be notified about events that happen in a Follow Up Boss account.
